title: Letters and Summer
author: Astrid Underhill
blurb: Odile Voss, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
